name: SWT-Bench Verified
description: A human-verified 433-instance split of SWT-Bench where instances have been quality-checked to ensure reproducibility and well-formed test conditions. Models must generate unit tests that fail before the canonical bug-fix patch and pass after, across 12 popular Python repositories. The verified split is the primary leaderboard target for reporting state-of-the-art test-generation results.
evaluation_method: success rate (tests fail before patch, pass after); coverage increase (ΔC) on resolving patch
general_score_metric: success rate 𝒮 (% of issues reproduced); coverage increase ΔC
typical_sota_score: ~87% success, ~70% ΔC (TEX-T by Salesforce using Claude Sonnet, 2025); ~84% (LogicStar L*Agent v1); ~80% (OpenHands with GPT-5); baseline pass-to-pass rate: 15.01%
reputation: NeurIPS 2024; the standard leaderboard split for SWT-Bench; human-verified instances ensure evaluation quality; leaderboard at swtbench.com; top venue for reporting test-generation SOTA
notes: 433-instance human-verified subset of SWT-Bench Full. Primary leaderboard split. BM25 retrieval provides 27k-token context (cl100k_base). Two prompt formats: eth-sri/SWT-bench_Verified_bm25_27k_zsb and eth-sri/SWT-bench_Verified_bm25_27k_zsp. Upper bound (gold oracle pass-to-pass rate) is 15.01%, reflecting that many canonical patches lack comprehensive test coverage. arXiv: 2406.12952.

institutions: ETH Zurich (SRI Lab — Secure, Reliable, and Intelligent Systems Lab)
